title: 第二十一章 一剑枭首第二十二章 天剑宗叶寒梅
content_zh:
第二十一章：一剑枭首这一剑速度极快，金丹境界实力加持之下，其威力更是惊人。
但以苏命神皇境界的眼光来看，却是又慢又弱。
“住手！”
族老苏然正准备出手阻止。
但苏命的速度更快。只见率先他一手伸出，两根手指轻轻一夹，原本那气势如虹的长剑顿时苏命双指夹住。
长剑嗡鸣，但它却像被铁水焊死一般，死死定在苏命双指之间，再不得寸进分毫。
“这……这怎么可能？！”
看到这一幕所有人都露出呆若木鸡，无比震惊的模样。
尤其是柳关山更是眉头紧锁，他自诩，自己也做不到如苏命般轻易接下那一剑。
“苏命……都已经成长到这一步了吗？”
还不等众人反应，苏命已经一拳轰出。
气海境六层，但堪比金丹境界的灵气轰然爆发。
苏命的一拳狠狠轰在胡耽胸口，直接在他胸口轰出一个深坑。下一刻，胡耽瞬间倒飞出去，重重砸落在屋外，生死不知。
这一切都发生在电光火石之间，速度快到连赵明出声喝止都来不及。
等众人反应过来，胡耽已经瘫在了院外。
赵明脸色阴晴不定，片刻后勃然大怒道：
“苏命，你当真是要和我赵家开战不成？”
泥人还有三分火气，苏命这番举动完全是没把赵家放在眼里，这彻底激怒了身为赵家主的赵明。
一旁的王家家主王玉和他儿子王腾也是心头狂震。
“没想到苏命废了这么多年，如今一露面就如此之强。”

“只可惜啊，他虽然变强了，但是没有脑子，一举得罪赵家和柳家，就算苏家有心，恐怕也保不住他。”
“哼，像苏命这样的天才我见多了，不过就是昙花一现而已。”
两人窃窃私语，眼底皆是泛着看好戏的神色。
“我之前就说过了，我根本就不介意和你赵家开战。”苏命依旧脸色平淡：“再者，动手要杀我的可是他，我不过反击而已有什么错？”
“巧舌如簧！”赵明勃然大怒：“就算我不追究你伤我赵家长老一事，我也要为我女儿教训教训你这不知天高地厚的小子。”
说话间，赵明一步踏出，在他身上，金丹八层的气息爆发而出。
“我来助你！”柳关山也是一步走到赵明身旁：“此子凶恶万分，若不及早铲除，必定危害世间！”
看着眼前两人，苏命眼眸微沉：“两个一起来吗?正好，那就一起解决了。”
千钧一发之际，苏然一步跨出，挡在了三人中间。
发须轻颤，苏然布满褶皱的脸上露出愠怒之色，他看着赵明和柳关山：“这可是在我苏家，你们此举，还有没有把老夫、把苏家放在眼里？”
柳关山怒喝道：“苏命犯下滔天之错，其罪必须用鲜血才能洗刷，今日不杀他，来日他恐怕还会闯出更大的祸患。”
“就是！”赵明也是沉声道：“苏老爷子，我一直很敬重您，但您今日要是拦着我，也别怪我不敬了。”
苏然沉思片刻，坚定摇头道：“苏天临走时将苏命托付给我。所以无论苏命犯下多大的过错，我至少也要等到他回来。”
柳关山眼眸一冷，语气阴沉道：“所以，老爷子你是非要和我们过不去了？”
苏然面露犹豫，片刻后像是做出什么决定，脸色坚定无比。
还没开口，苏命的身影已经出现在了他面前。
递给老爷子一个你放心的眼色，苏命转头看向柳关山和赵明，食指微微一勾道：
“两个老东西，上来领死！”
两人对视一眼，目光中皆是露出震怒之色。
“狂妄！”
content_en:
Chapter 21: One Sword Owl Head This sword is extremely fast, and with the blessing of the Golden Core realm, its power is even more amazing.
But from the perspective of the Su Ming God Emperor, it was slow and weak.
"Stop!"
Clan elder Su Ran was about to stop him.
But Su Ming was faster. He took the lead and stretched out one hand, pinched it gently with two fingers, and the long sword that was originally so powerful was suddenly clamped between his fingers.
The long sword buzzed, but it seemed to be welded to death by molten iron. It was firmly fixed between Su Ming's two fingers, unable to make any further progress.
"This...how is this possible?!"
Seeing this scene, everyone looked dumbfounded and extremely shocked.
Especially Liu Guanshan frowned. He boasted that he could not take the sword as easily as Su Ming.
"Su Ming...has he grown to this point?"
Before anyone could react, Su Ming had already punched out.
At the sixth level of the Qi Sea Realm, spiritual energy comparable to the Golden Core Realm exploded.
Su Ming's punch hit Hu Dan's chest hard, creating a deep hole in his chest. The next moment, Hu Dan flew out instantly and landed heavily outside the house. He didn't know whether he was alive or dead.
All this happened in the blink of an eye, so fast that even Zhao Ming had no time to stop him.
By the time everyone reacted, Hu Dan had already collapsed outside the hospital.
Zhao Ming's face was uncertain, and after a moment he became furious and said:
"Su Ming, do you really want to start a war with my Zhao family?"
The clay figurine was still angry. Su Ming's actions completely ignored the Zhao family, which completely angered Zhao Ming, the head of the Zhao family.
The head of the Wang family, Wang Yu and his son Wang Teng, were also shocked.
"I didn't expect that Su Ming would be so strong when he showed up now after being wasted for so many years."
"It's a pity that although he has become stronger, he has no brains and offended the Zhao family and the Liu family in one fell swoop. Even if the Su family has intentions, they probably won't be able to save him."
"Hmph, I have seen many geniuses like Su Ming, but they are just short-lived."
The two of them were whispering, their eyes looking like they were watching a good show.
"I've said it before, I don't mind starting a war with your Zhao family at all." Su Ming's expression remained calm: "Besides, he was the one who wanted to kill me. What's wrong with me just fighting back?"
"Speaking like a glib!" Zhao Ming was furious: "Even if I don't hold you accountable for hurting my elder Zhao family, I will teach my daughter a lesson for you, a brat who doesn't know the heights of heaven and earth."
As he spoke, Zhao Ming took a step forward, and the aura of the eighth level of the golden elixir burst out from him.
"I'm here to help you!" Liu Guanshan also walked to Zhao Ming's side: "This boy is extremely vicious. If he is not eradicated as soon as possible, he will definitely endanger the world!"
Looking at the two people in front of him, Su Ming's eyes darkened slightly: "Are you two coming together? It's just right. Let's solve it together."
At the critical moment, Su Ran stepped forward and stood between the three of them.
His hair and beard trembled slightly, and Su Ran's wrinkled face showed a sullen look. He looked at Zhao Ming and Liu Guanshan: "This is in my Su family. By doing this, do you still put me and the Su family in your eyes?"
Liu Guanshan shouted angrily: "Su Ming made a heinous mistake, and his crime must be washed away with blood. If we don't kill him today, I'm afraid he will cause even greater trouble in the future."
"That's right!" Zhao Ming also said in a deep voice: "Mr. Su, I have always respected you, but if you stop me today, don't blame me for being disrespectful."
Su Ran pondered for a moment, shook his head firmly and said, "Su Tian entrusted Su Ming to me before he left. So no matter how big a mistake Su Ming made, I will at least wait until he comes back."
Liu Guanshan's eyes turned cold and he said in a gloomy tone: "So, old man, do you really want to make things difficult for us?"
Su Ran looked hesitant. After a moment, he seemed to have made a decision, and his face became firm.
Before he could speak, Su Ming's figure had already appeared in front of him.
Giving the old man a reassuring look, Su Ming turned to look at Liu GuanshanHe Zhao Ming curled his index finger slightly and said:
"Two old guys, come up and lead us to death!"
The two looked at each other with anger in their eyes.
"Arrogant!"
